faq.question: What is Relay?
faq.answer: Relay is the data directory and research layer for fintech infrastructure. It maps providers, payment rails, fees, coverage, and market intelligence so teams expanding across the Americas, Europe, Africa, and other regions can shortlist partners with evidence.

faq.question: Which regions does Relay cover?
faq.answer: Relay focuses on global expansion corridors with depth in the United States, Canada, Europe, the United Kingdom, Africa, Latin America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific payment markets.

faq.question: What kind of research does Relay publish?
faq.answer: Relay Research publishes market maps, corridor benchmarks, and infrastructure deep dives — including flagship analysis on global transactional volumes, digital wallets, instant payments, remittances, and regional fintech rails.

faq.question: How do I contact Relay sales?
faq.answer: Book a conversation on Calendly via Contact sales, or email support@relay.gratebridge.com. Join the waitlist on the site for product access.

about.title: About Relay
about.lede: Relay is the data directory and insights layer for fintech infrastructure across markets worldwide.

sections.title: What we do
body: Teams expanding into new corridors need more than a sales deck. Relay maps vetted providers by market and category, surfaces fees, rails, coverage, and reliability signals, and helps you shortlist partners you can actually ship with.
When you are ready, Relay can introduce you to provider teams — so outreach starts with context, not cold guessing.

sections.title: Who we are
body: Relay is built by GrateBridge Labs. We work with builders and operators evaluating payment, KYC, FX, and banking infrastructure as they expand globally.

sections.title: Talk to us
body: For product access, join the waitlist from the site. For partnerships and sales conversations, book time on Calendly or email support@relay.gratebridge.com.

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.lede: How we compile provider data, benchmarks, and market reports.

sections.title: Sources
body: Provider entries and report findings are compiled from public documentation, product materials, builder reports, and direct conversations with operators. Where figures are indicative, we say so.

sections.title: What we publish
body: Directory fields focus on category, markets, rails, fees ranges, coverage, and integration signals. Research papers go deeper on a corridor, rail, or category — with methodology notes on each report.

sections.title: Limits
body: Fees, settlement times, and coverage change. Relay is not a payment institution and does not provide financial, legal, or regulatory advice. Always validate critical terms with the provider before you commit.

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lede: How GrateBridge Labs handles information you share with Relay.

sections.title: What we collect
body: When you join the waitlist, create an account, or contact us, we collect the details you provide — such as name, work email, role, and company. We also collect basic usage data needed to operate and improve the product.

sections.title: How we use it
body: We use this information to operate Relay, respond to requests, improve the directory and reports experience, and communicate about access or product updates. We do not sell your personal information.

sections.title: Contact
body: Questions about privacy can be sent to support@relay.gratebridge.com.

terms.title: Terms
terms.lede: Terms of use for the Relay website and related services.

sections.title: Using Relay
body: Relay provides directory information, research, and introduction workflows for informational purposes. You are responsible for how you use that information when evaluating providers or making commercial decisions.

sections.title: Accuracy
body: We work to keep data current, but listings and report figures may be incomplete or change without notice. Confirm critical details directly with providers before contracting.

sections.title: Accounts
body: If you create an account, keep your credentials secure and provide accurate information. We may suspend access that abuses the service or violates these terms.

sections.title: Contact
body: For questions about these terms, email support@relay.gratebridge.com.
